purpose: Teach: 列島/知覚/垂直/特異/不利益/中枢/著しい/ノード

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、列島各地の救急医療体制を医療チームで研究しております
lines.en: Ren, we're conducting a research study on emergency medical systems across the country with our medical team.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady pace. Warm but measured — not distant, just appropriately clinical. Eye contact suggests she's speaking to him as a peer in the conversation, not down to him.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 知覚障害の患者さんを医療チームは慎重に診ます
lines.en: When we see patients with perceptual disorders, our medical team takes a very careful diagnostic approach.
lines.style: Calm, deliberate. Slight emphasis on 'careful' — not as caution, but as commitment. Voice settles into the rhythm of routine excellence. No rush.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 貴院、垂直型の救急棟を建設されるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I hear your hospital is constructing a vertical emergency wing, Doctor.
lines.style: Respectful, genuinely interested. Small lean forward in the voice. Not flattering — honest curiosity, maybe a touch of admiration for the ambition. Clean, attentive phrasing.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、特異な症状の患者さんを医療チームは丁寧に診ます
lines.en: Yes — patients with unusual symptoms receive very thorough evaluation from our team.
lines.style: Same steady composure as before. Slight warmth on 'thorough' — not defensive, just quietly proud of the standard. Unhurried.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療費の不利益を被る患者さんに、貴院、配慮されますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital really does look out for patients who face financial barriers to care, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, not quite asking — more like he's recognizing something he's noticed. Gentle, no edge of accusation. Respectful uncertainty at the end, leaving room for her to answer fully.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、脳中枢の機能を医療チームは丁寧に評価します
lines.en: Yes — we evaluate central nervous system function very carefully with each patient.
lines.style: Same measured baseline. Perhaps the tiniest hint of weight on 'carefully' — she knows he's asking about something larger than the sentence itself. Still patient. Still present.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療の進歩が著しいと貴院も実感されますね、先生
lines.en: Medical progress really is remarkable, and your hospital lives that every day, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Softer now, more personal. He's moved beyond asking into reflecting alongside her. Genuine respect, no performance. Voice settles like he's comfortable sitting in this conversation longer.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい、地域医療のノード機能を貴院は担っておられます
lines.en: Yes — our hospital does serve as a kind of hub for regional healthcare.
lines.style: Gentle acknowledgment. No inflection of self-importance — just stating the fact quietly. Voice shows she recognizes what he's really saying: that he sees what she and her team do. Warm close.
